why: The circle must continue the lines of the big square. The slanting edge runs from bottom-left to top-right with black below it, and the two thin lines come in from the top and from the left. Option 3 shows exactly this. Option 4 has the black on the wrong side.
trick: For a hole in a picture, extend every line and colour of the picture into the hole.
